content.linkedin:
Deep-Dive: The Architecture of an AI-Native Social Media Engine

When designing Omnipost, our goal was to allow AI agents like Claude and Cursor to execute safe, schema-validated social actions without human babysitting.

Key architectural pillars:
1. Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP schemas with Pydantic validation
2. In-memory Unicode typographic translation engine
3. Zero-telemetry, zero-cookie Material 3 visual studio
4. Isolated rate-limiting queues with exponential backoff

Full engineering documentation in our repo: https://github.com/omnipost/omnipost-social-engine/blob/main/docs/MCP_GUIDE.md

#PythonArchitecture #SystemDesign #MCP #AIInfrastructure
